bagPolicy.summary: Cotton Bowl Stadium permits clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, one-gallon clear bags and nonclear clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches. Other bags are prohibited; medical device bags are inspected.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Fair Park’s main vehicle entrances are Gates 5 and 6 on Robert B. Cullum Boulevard. Event-specific parking may have a fee even though ordinary daily park parking is free; check the concert page.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Fair Park says rideshare drop-off and pickup can take place outside its gates, with event-specific arrangements announced on the event page.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Outside food and beverages are listed as prohibited for Cotton Bowl Stadium events. The park’s visitor pages do not provide a universal concert concession menu.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking is available throughout Fair Park; tell the attendant at Gates 5 or 6 that you need an accessible space.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Fair Park’s general visitor guidance does not publish a specific Cotton Bowl concert re-entry rule.

gates.summary: Use the event’s published checkpoints and designated entrances; vehicle Gates 5 and 6 serve Fair Park parking. The stadium bag policy may change with the event.
